item: background task output + Run in background (11.7): a roster row opens a polled output pane; a running foreground tool line offers to move the call to the background
branch: offerBackground(): task_started{is_backgrounded:false, tool_use_id} on a .run tool line appends .t-bg → click → bridge{kind:'backgroundTask', id: tool_use_id} once; __backgrounded{backgrounded:true} removes it, {backgrounded:false} / errors make it a .note, the disabled error ends offers (bgRefused). renderBgTasks(): every row toggles a .bg-out pane; bgOutTick asks bridge{kind:'taskOutput', id: task_id} once a second while the popup is shown and the pane open, one ask in flight; __taskOutput paints the pre through taskOutText (trailing newline, \r, truncated head), an error answer ends polling; the roster dropping the task drops the pane and the timer.
provenance:
PROBED 2026-10-10 on 2.1.296 over stdio (scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, haiku, --permission-mode default): a foreground Bash gets task_started{task_id, run_id, tool_use_id, description, is_backgrounded:false, task_type:'local_bash'} ~3 s in; background_tasks{tool_use_id} answered {backgrounded:true} with background_tasks_changed (items now carry run_id) + task_updated{patch:{is_backgrounded:true}} in the same instant, then the tool_result 'Command was manually backgrounded by user with ID: …' and the turn's result. get_task_output{task_id} answered {output, total_bytes, truncated} ('' / 0 / false before the first line; the ended task's whole output + '

[exited with code 0]
'); an unknown id the error 'get_task_output: no shell or Monitor task with that task_id in this session'. The __backgrounded / __taskOutput frames are OUR Kotlin relay (ChatPanel), shaped 1:1 from those answers; the disabled error text is from `strings` (unmeasured); the  / truncated-head display rules are the reference client's (2.1.296 webview, read). NEGATIVE CONTROLS: step 10 (a background-from-the-start launch draws no button), step 6b (no ask while the popup is hidden), step 8 (no ask after an error answer), step 12b (a settled line drops a live button, keeps a note). RUNS 2026-10-10: on the PRE-CHANGE sandbox (launched before any edit) the first discriminating assert failed (0 offers) and step 1 aborted on the missing button; on the first changed build 40/44 — steps 6a/6b/8 showed ONE ask ever (the row click bubbled to the document handler with its row already rebuilt and detached, so the popup closed as an 'outside click' — stack captured over CDP), fixed with stopPropagation on the row, plus the step-4 popup-stays-shown assert that only the fix passes; then 45/45.

steps.note: 1 — a running foreground Bash + task_started{is_backgrounded:false}: the tool line grows a 'Run in background' button
steps.setup: window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'__clear'})); if (!window.__realBridge95) { window.__realBridge95 = window.__bridge; } window.__tape95 = []; window.__bridge = function(j){ window.__tape95.push(JSON.parse(j)); }; addUserMessage('run the loop', [], Date.now());

expect.why: exactly one offer on the line
the reference client's wording
the line is still in flight
clickable until clicked

steps.note: 2 — click: ONE backgroundTask bridge call carrying the tool_use_id; a second click is swallowed; the button disables

expect.why: one call, the tool_use_id (background_tasks{tool_use_id} is what Kotlin sends)
no second click while the CLI decides

steps.note: 3 — the CLI's answer true: the button goes; the roster frame + task_updated{is_backgrounded:true} that follow (measured together) list the task; the measured tool_result settles the line

content.content: Command was manually backgrounded by user with ID: t_fg. Output is being written to: /tmp/x/tasks/t_fg.output. If it is still running after 30m in the background, it will be stopped and you will be notified.

expect.why: a moved call offers nothing more
the offer record is gone too
the roster lists the moved shell
chip reflects the roster
the 'manually backgrounded' tool_result settles the line (not internal metadata)

steps.note: 4 — open the row's output pane (popup shown): one taskOutput ask with the task_id, the pane present and empty until the answer, the poll timer running

expect.why: one ask, keyed by task_id (get_task_output{task_id})
the pane sits under its row
the row says it is open (chevron rotates on this)
nothing painted before the first answer
the once-a-second timer is running
the row click must not bubble to the document handler that closes popups (it did, 2026-10-10: the poll then saw a hidden popup and never re-asked)

steps.note: 5 — the answer paints the pre: one trailing newline dropped, \r honoured like a terminal (the text after the last \r on a line), no size note when not truncated

expect.why: taskOutText: CRLF line kept, overwritten progress shows its last state, trailing newline gone
no 'Showing the end of…' note on an untruncated stream
sanity: the ask count is readable

steps.note: 6a — the poll continues once a second after an answer: 1.3 s later exactly one more ask (one in flight at a time, so not two)

expect.why: the second ask came within a second of the answer and nothing re-asked while it is unanswered

steps.note: 6b — negative control: with the popup hidden nothing is asked, even after an answer frees the slot

expect.why: a hidden popup polls nothing
the answer still repainted the pane in place

steps.note: 7 — truncated: the partial first line goes and the note names the size (fmtSize of total_bytes)

steps.note: 8 — an error answer ('no shell or Monitor task…', the measured text) ends polling for that task: the pane says so and no ask follows in 1.3 s

nothing left to poll

steps.note: 10 — negative control: a launch that was background from the start (is_backgrounded:true, the measured frame for run_in_background:true) draws no button
